_description: Files that new-manuscript copies into a project and keeps managed — this file is the source (kept by hand). init_manuscript.py, update_tools.py and scripts/tool_hashes.py read it, and tool_hashes.json is generated from it. src is relative to this folder, dst to the project root, and {tools_dir} is the tools folder in that project's settings. The names these files had in 0.12 or earlier are in `tools/_config.py` (`LEGACY_TOOL_NAMES`) — update_tools.py moves them to the new names.
